stem.text: A ladder rests in equilibrium on rough ground against a rough wall.

stem.alt: Ladder with ends labelled P (against a rough wall) and Q (on rough ground), and centre of gravity labelled G.

stem.text: The weight $W$ of the ladder acts through the centre of gravity G. Forces also act on the ladder at P and at Q. These forces are $P$ and $Q$ respectively.
Which vector triangle represents the forces on the ladder?

A.alt: Closed vector triangle with arrows, labelled P, Q and W.

B.alt: Closed vector triangle with arrows, labelled P, Q and W.

C.alt: Closed vector triangle with arrows, labelled P, Q and W.

D.alt: Closed vector triangle with arrows, labelled P, Q and W.
